modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories

deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Perform unloading and bining of spare parts as per layout

pcs.pc_description: identify work requirement and material (spare parts, lubricants, fluids etc.) as per the instructions given by supervisor
take precautions to avoid damage to spare parts, lubricant/fluid containers during unloading/loading and handling
use suitable tools, equipment, PPE and technique for unloading/loading the spare parts, lubricant/fluid
carry out unboxing of received consignment and tally material as per invoice
report if notice any damage/discrepancies in received consignment to the person concerned
follow guidelines and carry out binning of items to designated place as per storage plan
dispose left over packing material as per organization’s policies

modules.module_title: Maintain inventory and storage facility by using automation systems

pcs.pc_description: obtain the work requirement and material (spare parts, lubricants, fluids etc.) details need to unload and store in the warehouse from supervisor
take precautions to avoid damage to spare parts, lubricant/fluid containers during unloading/loading and handling
check the functioning of robots before starting the work
feed the material storage data in the control system of the robots i.e. type of material, quantity, bin no. etc. by following SoP/WI
use automated systems and robots to segregate items from one another using storage boxes-bins, plastic separators etc.
monitor the robots and ensure that they are storing the correct material in correct bin/place
report if notice any damage/discrepancies in material to the person concerned
monitor the control system and ensure that correct data of material storage is updating in the inventory through automated inventory management system
use cleaning robots to dispose left over packing material as per organization’s policies
assist supervisor in recording and maintaining data of stock records by following SoP/WI

modules.module_title: Process orders by using automation systems

pcs.pc_description: obtain and check the product/material details/BOM need to be dispatch or process out from inventory for manufacturing
feed the product/material picking details in the control system
monitor and ensure that robot is locating and picking correct product/material as per order/parts requisition slip/instructions
collect the product/material at collection point from the robot and release the product/material after checking and completing the required documentation
monitor the control system and ensure that correct data of material moving out is updating in the inventory through automated inventory management system
